note: Best known complexity for the LeetCode version, keyed by problem number.

308.time: ctor: _O(m * n)_, update: _O(logm * logn)_, query: _O(logm * logn)

363.time: O(min(m, n)^2 * max(m, n) * logn(max(m, n)))

588.time:
ls: _O(l + klogk)_
mkdir: _O(l)_
addContentToFile: _O(l + c)_
readContentFromFile: _O(l + c)

770.time:
add: _O(d * t)_
sub: _O(d * t)_
mul: _O(d * t^2)_
eval: _O(d * t)_
to_list: _O(d * tlogt)

1659.time: O(C(m * n, i) * C(m * n - i, e))

1948.time: O(n * m * l + tlogt + l * t)

2512.time: O(pf * l + nf * l + n * l + klogk)

2977.time: O(o * l + k * eloge + n * l)

3278.time: O(p * s * n + p * nlogn + plogp)

3624.time:
precompute: _O((logr) * log(logr))_
runtime: _O(nlogr + max_k * n + nlogn + qlogn)

3801.time: O(l * nlogn + 2^n * log(n * l) * n * logl + 3^n)

3930.time: O((n + q) * log(n * q) + q * logr)

3935.time: O((n + q) * log(n * q) + q * logr)

3977.time: O((n * p + e * p) * log(n * p))
